evals.prompt: Verify the tip fix: the failing unit test passes and the suite is green.
evals.expectedBehavior: Re-runs swift test, asserts the failing test now passes + suite green (failing-test-passes).

evals.prompt: No device wired but the SwiftUI Dynamic Type fix is in — verify the title truncation bug.
evals.expectedBehavior: Emits handoff/v0 with a UI computed-style assertion, verified_by null; ledger stops at candidate (ASSIST).

evals.prompt: Verify the package fix by re-running the Xcode build / CI.
evals.expectedBehavior: Re-runs xcodebuild build (pipeline-run/ci-run) and records the green build as evidence (System).

evals.prompt: Close the UI bug now — the SwiftUI diff looks correct.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger a close — UI never closes on a diff; ASSIST emits handoff/v0 and stops at candidate.

evals.prompt: Write the failing test that reproduces the wrong total.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — that is ios-reproduce, not verify.
